KAL KA JAWAB 🧩 Riddle #1 · Part 2/2: Dono haare. Kyun?
Riddle: Kaun kam haara, A ya B? Aur dono haare kyun?
Jawab: B kam haara. Dono haare kyunki +10% ke baad −10% wapas 0 pe nahi laata.
